name: Germany
description: Germany from Charlemagne and the Holy Roman Empire to unification, two world wars, division and reunification.

checkpoints.name: Tribes and emperors
checkpoints.note: Germanic tribes destroyed three Roman legions in the Teutoburg Forest. Charlemagne ruled the Franks, and the Holy Roman Empire held the German lands loosely together. Gutenberg printed with movable type.

checkpoints.name: Reformation and Prussia
checkpoints.note: Luther's theses split the Church, and the Thirty Years' War devastated the land. Prussia rose under Frederick the Great, Bach, Kant, Goethe and Beethoven worked, and Bismarck united Germany by war.

checkpoints.name: Empire and republic
checkpoints.note: The German Empire was proclaimed in 1871. It lost the First World War, and the Weimar Republic suffered hyperinflation while the Bauhaus and Einstein flourished.

checkpoints.name: The Nazi years
checkpoints.note: Hitler took power in 1933. The Nazis persecuted Jews, started the Second World War and murdered six million Jews in the Holocaust, until Berlin fell in 1945.

checkpoints.name: Division and reunification
checkpoints.note: Germany was split into West and East, and in 1961 the Berlin Wall divided Berlin. The wall fell in 1989 and the country reunited. Merkel led it through the financial and migrant crises, Scholz through the war in Ukraine, and Merz took over in 2025.
